meaning:
συν-ανα-μίγνυμι
(accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: Hos.7:8 A ( hithpo.), Eze.20:18 A * ;]
to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): 1Co.5:9 5:11, 2Th.3:14 (see M, Th., 117).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
